subject: Quick ask: short exec quote & one-pager for NovaNet case study
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
To: Diane Lopez <diane@novanet.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask: short exec quote & one-pager for NovaNet case study

Hi Diane,

Hope you're doing well — congrats again on the successful launch of the NovaNet recommendation pipeline with Redwood. We were asked by field to ship a short one-pager + a single slide that highlights the impact for prospects.

Two small asks if you have 10 minutes:
- A 1–2 sentence executive quote we can use on the one-pager/slide (something about latency, cost savings, business impact, or trust in the platform).
- Permission to use the NovaNet logo and a customer headshot (if available) for the marketing asset.

If easier, feel free to pick from these options and tweak:
A) "Redwood Inference let us reduce inference costs by 40% while cutting p99 latency in half — it unlocked inline personalization at scale."
B) "Working with Redwood gave us predictable performance at a fraction of the operational overhead; we can ship features faster."

We plan to have a draft by EOD next Tuesday (June 29). If that's tight, a quick yay/nay on using the logo would be perfect.

Thanks — appreciate your help.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0132

Attachment: (none)

From: Diane Lopez <diane@novanet.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: marketing@novanet.com
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask: short exec quote & one-pager for NovaNet case study

Hi Jonas — happy to help. Thanks for the clear options; here's a short quote the exec team approved: 
"Redwood gave us predictable, low-latency inference at scale. We cut inference costs by ~38% and saw significant improvement in end-user engagement."

You have permission to use the NovaNet logo and the quote for marketing materials. I attached the RGB and monochrome logos. Please work with our marketing inbox for any branding approvals: marketing@novanet.com.

Also: if you want a short customer metric to call out on the slide, use: "38% inference cost reduction; p95 latency improved from 420ms to 180ms."

Cheers,
Diane Lopez
VP, Product 
NovaNet Analytics

Attachment: NovaNet_Logo_RGB.png

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Fwd: Quick ask: short exec quote & one-pager for NovaNet case study

Marissa / Laura — forwarding Diane's approval and logo. Diane gave us the quote below and permission to use the logo; marketing cc'd their inbox for brand sign-off.

Quote: "Redwood gave us predictable, low-latency inference at scale. We cut inference costs by ~38% and saw significant improvement in end-user engagement."
Metrics: 38% inference cost reduction; p95 latency improved from 420ms to 180ms.

Can you please:
- Draft a one-pager (single PDF) + a 16:9 slide focused on the business outcome by Wed EOD (June 30).
- Pull a 1-line soundbite for the slide and a 1-sentence pull-quote for the one-pager.
- Make sure the metrics are called out exactly as Diane provided and add a small note: "Customer provided metrics; Redwood verified during onboarding."

Connor, once Marissa shares drafts, can you run a quick legal check on the quote usage?

Happy to introduce you to NovaNet marketing if needed.

Thanks — Jonas

- Slide: emphasis on business outcome + visual of latency improvement.

Request:

- Laura: can you create a 20-30 word social blurb for LinkedIn from the quote (we'll tag NovaNet if they approve).

If everybody thumbs up by tomorrow noon, we can push to the field enablement pack for next week's SDR outreach.
